description:
Moves the archive and snapshot-export methods onto an `archive()` facade.

## Background

`CommandExecutor` (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs`) carries every command family in one public surface of about 195 methods across 28 `impl` blocks, so a consumer of one family accepts all of them. This family lives in `commands/archive.rs` (an `IssueStore` block and a `JsonFileStorage` block) and `commands/snapshot.rs`: `archive_candidates`, `preview_archive_document`, `preview_archive_container`, `execute_archive_document`, `execute_archive_container`, `determine_snapshot_source_mode` and `export_snapshot`. Callers: the archive and snapshot arms of `crates/jit/src/main.rs` (or their handler modules) and the archive and snapshot suites.

The facade shape: `CommandExecutor::<family>()` returns a borrowing struct holding `&CommandExecutor<S>`; the family's methods live in `impl` blocks on that struct in the family's own `commands/` file, and each block keeps the storage bound its `impl CommandExecutor` block had (`IssueStore`, `IssueStore + RepositoryStateStore`, or concrete `JsonFileStorage`). The kernel (sessions, rule and config caches, `require_active_lease`, the validation `capture_*` helpers) stays on `CommandExecutor`; a facade method reaches it through its executor reference, and calls into another family go through that family's accessor.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `CommandExecutor::archive()` returns `ArchiveOps<'_, S>`, re-exported from `jit::commands`, and every public method listed in the Background is a method of `ArchiveOps` rather than of `CommandExecutor`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each `ArchiveOps` impl block for these methods carries the storage bound of the `CommandExecutor` block it replaces, so no method becomes callable on a storage it could not use before.
- [hard] REQ-03: Callers in `crates/jit`, `crates/server` and their test suites reach the moved methods through `archive()`, intra-doc links name the new paths, and the workspace builds, lints and passes its existing suites with no assertion changed.

## Notes

- Behaviour, output and exit codes are unchanged; the compile and the existing suites are the test boundary.
- Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md` (D-1); method inventory: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/investigation.md` area 3.
title: Archive and snapshot methods behind an archive facade
